1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# scripts/benchmark/benchmark — operator-facing benchmark driver.
3	#
4	# Replaces `fiz-bench sweep` / `fiz-bench matrix` execution. Pure shell:
5	# yq + jq + sha256sum + docker. No Go bridge, no Python.
6	#
7	# Bead fizeau-fe87a3ac: skeleton + listing subcommands + --plan mode +
8	# preflight rebuild gate. The cell execution loop (resume, retry, signal
9	# handling, concurrency, budget) lands in a follow-up bead.
10	#
11	# Operator contract:
12	#   ./benchmark profiles
13	#   ./benchmark bench-sets
14	#   ./benchmark harness-adapters
15	#   ./benchmark task-executors
16	#   ./benchmark validate                            # placeholder; see PR C
17	#   ./benchmark preflight                           # rebuild harbor-runner if sha drifted
18	#   ./benchmark --profile P[,P2,...] --bench-set B[,B2,...] --plan
19	#   ./benchmark --profile P[,P2,...] --bench-set B[,B2,...]   # run path; PR A4
20	#
21	# Rules:
22	#   1. --plan is pure: no file writes, no Docker pulls/builds, no
23	#      benchmark-results/ creation. Prints one matrix line per cell.
24	#   2. --profile and --bench-set are both required for --plan and run.
25	#   3. preflight is the only command that touches Docker.
26

28

30	PROFILES_DIR="${PROFILES_DIR:-${SCRIPT_DIR}/profiles}"
31	BENCH_SETS_DIR="${BENCH_SETS_DIR:-${SCRIPT_DIR}/bench-sets}"

62	require_tool() {

64	}

66	# in_flight_state_dir returns the host-specific state directory.
67	in_flight_state_dir() {
68	  local hostname
69	  hostname="$(hostname)"
70	  printf '%s/%s\n' "${FIZEAU_BENCH_STATE_DIR}" "${hostname}"
71	}

73	# in_flight_lock_path returns the lock path for a concurrency group.
74	in_flight_lock_path() {
75	  local group="$1"
76	  printf '%s/locks/%s.lock\n' "${FIZEAU_BENCH_STATE_DIR}" "${group}"
77	}

84	# acquire_group_lock acquires an flock for a concurrency group, blocking if needed.
85	# Returns 0 on success, prints the lock fd to stdout.
86	acquire_group_lock() {
87	  local group="$1"
88	  local lock_path
89	  lock_path="$(in_flight_lock_path "${group}")"
90	  mkdir -p "$(dirname "${lock_path}")"
91	  local lock_fd
92	  lock_fd=200
93	  eval "exec ${lock_fd}>'${lock_path}'"
94	  flock "${lock_fd}" || die "failed to acquire lock for concurrency-group=${group}"
95	  printf '%d\n' "${lock_fd}"
96	}

98	# release_group_lock releases an flock acquired by acquire_group_lock.
99	release_group_lock() {
100	  local lock_fd="$1"

154	# register_inflight registers a cell as in-flight in the state file.
155	# Reads current entries, adds this cell, removes dead PIDs, writes back.
156	register_inflight() {
157	  local cell_id="$1" cell_dir="$2"
158	  local state_dir
159	  state_dir="$(in_flight_state_dir)"
160	  mkdir -p "${state_dir}"
161	  local json_path
162	  json_path="$(in_flight_json_path)"
163	
164	  local current_json="{\"cells\":[]}"
165	  [[ -f "${json_path}" ]] && current_json="$(cat "${json_path}")" || true
166	
167	  # Prune dead PIDs by filtering in bash
168	  local live_cells=()
169	  local cell_json pid
170	  while IFS= read -r cell_json; do
171	    [[ -z "${cell_json}" ]] && continue
172	    pid="$(jq -r '.pid' <<<"${cell_json}")"
173	    if [[ -n "${pid}" ]] && kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
174	      live_cells+=("${cell_json}")
175	    fi
176	  done < <(jq -r '.cells[] | @json' <<<"${current_json}")
177	
178	  # Rebuild with live cells
179	  current_json="$(printf '%s\n' "${live_cells[@]}" | jq -s '{cells:.}')"
180	
181	  # Add this cell
182	  current_json="$(jq \
183	    --arg cell_id "${cell_id}" \
184	    --arg cell_dir "${cell_dir}" \
185	    --argjson pid "${BASHPID}" \
186	    '.cells += [{cell_id:$cell_id, cell_dir:$cell_dir, pid:$pid}]' \
187	    <<<"${current_json}")"
188	
189	  printf '%s\n' "${current_json}" >"${json_path}.tmp"
190	  mv "${json_path}.tmp" "${json_path}"
191	}

195	unregister_inflight() {
196	  local cell_id="$1"
197	  local json_path
198	  json_path="$(in_flight_json_path)"
199	  [[ -f "${json_path}" ]] || return 0
200	
201	  local updated
202	  updated="$(jq \
203	    --arg cell_id "${cell_id}" \
204	    '.cells |= map(select(.cell_id != $cell_id))' \
205	    "${json_path}")"
206	
207	  printf '%s\n' "${updated}" >"${json_path}.tmp"
208	  mv "${json_path}.tmp" "${json_path}"

211	# interrupt_inflight_cells is called during signal handling. For each in-flight cell:
212	#   1. SIGTERM the cell's process group
213	#   2. docker stop containers matching the cell's label (--time=30s grace)
214	#   3. Wait up to grace_seconds for containers to stop
215	#   4. Force-kill any stragglers with docker kill
216	# Also removes the cell from in-flight.json.
217	interrupt_inflight_cells() {
218	  local grace_seconds="${BENCH_TERM_GRACE_SECONDS:-30}"
219	  local json_path
220	  json_path="$(in_flight_json_path)"
221	  [[ -f "${json_path}" ]] || return 0
222	
223	  local cells
224	  cells="$(jq -r '.cells[] | @json' "${json_path}")" || return 0
225	
226	  local cell_id cell_dir pid
227	  local cell_count=0
228	  local cells_to_kill=()
229	
230	  while IFS= read -r cell_json; do
231	    [[ -z "${cell_json}" ]] && continue
232	    cell_id="$(jq -r '.cell_id' <<<"${cell_json}")"
233	    cell_dir="$(jq -r '.cell_dir' <<<"${cell_json}")"
234	    pid="$(jq -r '.pid' <<<"${cell_json}")"
235	
236	    [[ -n "${cell_id}" ]] || continue
237	    cells_to_kill+=("${cell_id}:${pid}")
238	    cell_count=$((cell_count + 1))
239	
240	    # SIGTERM the cell's process group (try both negative PID for process group and regular PID)
241	    if [[ -n "${pid}" ]] && (( pid > 0 )); then
242	      kill -TERM -"${pid}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || kill -TERM "${pid}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
243	    fi
244	  done <<<"${cells}"
245	
246	  # If there are containers to stop, do so with a grace period
247	  if [[ ${cell_count} -gt 0 ]]; then
248	    for cell_spec in "${cells_to_kill[@]}"; do
249	      cell_id="${cell_spec%:*}"
250	      docker ps -q --filter "label=fizeau-cell=${cell_id}" 2>/dev/null \
251	        | xargs -r docker stop --time=30 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
252	    done
253	
254	    # Wait a bit for containers to actually stop
255	    sleep 2
256	
257	    # Force-kill any remaining containers that didn't stop
258	    for cell_spec in "${cells_to_kill[@]}"; do
259	      cell_id="${cell_spec%:*}"
260	      docker ps -q --filter "label=fizeau-cell=${cell_id}" 2>/dev/null \
261	        | xargs -r docker kill >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
262	    done
263	  fi
264	
265	  # Clear in-flight entries (they should have trap handlers that do this too, but be explicit)
266	  : >"${json_path}.tmp"
267	  printf '{"cells":[]}\n' >"${json_path}.tmp"
268	  mv "${json_path}.tmp" "${json_path}"
269	}

391	# resolve_tasks emits one task id per line for a bench-set.
392	# Handles three shapes:
393	#   tasks: [id, id, ...]         inline list
394	#   tasks: all                   defer to harness dataset; emit "*all*"
395	#   tasks_from: <path>           load tasks[].id from a sibling YAML
396	# tasks_from and inline tasks merge in deterministic order with duplicates
397	# removed on first occurrence.
398	resolve_tasks() {
399	  local bs_file="$1"
400	  local bs_json tasks_kind tasks_from
401	  bs_json="$(bench_set_json "${bs_file}")"
402	
403	  tasks_kind="$(jq -r '
404	    if (.tasks // null) == null then "none"
405	    elif (.tasks | type) == "array" then "list"
406	    elif (.tasks | type) == "string" then ("string:" + .tasks)
407	    else "other"
408	    end' <<<"${bs_json}")"
409	
410	  tasks_from="$(jq -r '.tasks_from // ""' <<<"${bs_json}")"
411	
412	  if [[ "${tasks_kind}" == "string:all" ]]; then
413	    [[ -z "${tasks_from}" ]] || die "bench-set ${bs_file}: tasks: all cannot be combined with tasks_from"
414	    # Defer to the harness dataset. The plan path emits a sentinel so
415	    # operators see the contract; the run path (PR A4) expands at execution.
416	    printf '*all*\n'
417	    return 0
418	  fi
419	
420	  local -A seen_tasks=()
421	  local emitted=0
422	  local task resolved
423	
424	  emit_task() {
425	    local task="$1"
426	    [[ -n "${task}" ]] || return 0
427	    if [[ -z "${seen_tasks["${task}"]+x}" ]]; then
428	      seen_tasks["${task}"]=1
429	      printf '%s\n' "${task}"
430	      emitted=1
431	    fi
432	  }
433	
434	  if [[ -n "${tasks_from}" ]]; then
435	    resolved="$(cd "$(dirname "${bs_file}")" && cd "$(dirname "${tasks_from}")" && pwd)/$(basename "${tasks_from}")"
436	    [[ -f "${resolved}" ]] || die "tasks_from path not found: ${tasks_from} (resolved to ${resolved})"
437	    while IFS= read -r task; do
438	      emit_task "${task}"
439	    done < <(
440	      yq -o=json '.' "${resolved}" \
441	        | jq -r '
442	            .tasks[]?
443	            | (if type == "object" then (.id // empty) else . end)
444	          '
445	    )
446	  fi
447	
448	  if [[ "${tasks_kind}" == "list" ]]; then
449	    while IFS= read -r task; do
450	      emit_task "${task}"
451	    done < <(jq -r '
452	      .tasks[] | (if type == "object" then (.id // empty) else . end)
453	    ' <<<"${bs_json}")
454	  elif [[ "${tasks_kind}" != "none" ]]; then
455	    die "bench-set ${bs_file}: unsupported tasks shape"
456	  fi
457	
458	  if [[ ${emitted} -eq 0 ]]; then
459	    if [[ -n "${tasks_from}" || "${tasks_kind}" == "list" ]]; then
460	      die "bench-set ${bs_file}: resolved no tasks"
461	    fi
462	    die "bench-set ${bs_file}: no .tasks list, .tasks: all, or .tasks_from set"
463	  fi
464	}

626	# every executable in scripts/benchmark/harness-adapters/.
627	validate_harness_adapters() {
628	  local tmpdir="$1" synthetic_profile="$2"
629	  local artifact="${tmpdir}/agent-artifact"
630	  : >"${artifact}"
631	
632	  local f name install_out command_out install_err command_err install_status command_status
633	  local files=()
634	  shopt -s nullglob dotglob
635	  for f in "${HARNESS_ADAPTERS_DIR}"/*; do
636	    [[ -f "${f}" && -x "${f}" ]] || continue
637	    files+=("${f}")
638	  done
639	  shopt -u nullglob dotglob
640	  [[ ${#files[@]} -gt 0 ]] || die "validate: no harness adapters found in ${HARNESS_ADAPTERS_DIR}"
641	
642	  for f in "${files[@]}"; do
643	    name="$(basename "${f}")"
644	    install_err="${tmpdir}/${name}.install.err"
645	    command_err="${tmpdir}/${name}.command.err"
646	
647	    set +e
648	    install_out="$("${f}" install "${artifact}" 2>"${install_err}")"
649	    install_status=$?
650	    set -e
651	    if [[ ${install_status} -ne 0 ]]; then
652	      die "validate: harness-adapter ${name} install failed: $(<"${install_err}")"
653	    fi
654	    jq -e '
655	      type == "object"
656	      and (.install_command | type == "string" and length > 0)
657	      and (.artifact_source | type == "string" and length > 0)
658	      and (.binary_path | type == "string")
659	      and (has("harbor_plugin"))
660	    ' <<<"${install_out}" >/dev/null \
661	      || die "validate: harness-adapter ${name} install output is malformed"
662	
663	    set +e
664	    command_out="$(printf '%s' "${synthetic_profile}" | "${f}" command 2>"${command_err}")"
665	    command_status=$?
666	    set -e
667	    if [[ ${command_status} -ne 0 ]]; then
668	      die "validate: harness-adapter ${name} command failed: $(<"${command_err}")"
669	    fi
670	    jq -e '
671	      type == "object"
672	      and (.command | type == "array" and length > 0)
673	      and all(.command[]?; type == "string")
674	      and (.env | type == "object")
675	      and all((.env // {}) | to_entries[]?; (.value | type == "string"))
676	      and (.secret_env_keys | type == "array")
677	      and ((.secret_env_keys | unique | length) == (.secret_env_keys | length))
678	      and (.env as $env | all(.secret_env_keys[]?; $env[.] != null))
679	    ' <<<"${command_out}" >/dev/null \
680	      || die "validate: harness-adapter ${name} command output is malformed"
681	  done

684	# validate_task_executors checks that every task-executor honors the dry-run
685	# contract and writes a valid result.json.
686	validate_task_executors() {
687	  local tmpdir="$1" synthetic_task_spec="$2"
688	  local f name stdout_file stderr_file cell_dir result_path status
689	  local files=()
690	  shopt -s nullglob dotglob
691	  for f in "${TASK_EXECUTORS_DIR}"/*; do
692	    [[ -f "${f}" && -x "${f}" ]] || continue
693	    files+=("${f}")
694	  done
695	  shopt -u nullglob dotglob
696	  [[ ${#files[@]} -gt 0 ]] || die "validate: no task executors found in ${TASK_EXECUTORS_DIR}"
697	
698	  for f in "${files[@]}"; do
699	    name="$(basename "${f}")"
700	    cell_dir="${tmpdir}/cell"
701	    mkdir -p "${cell_dir}"
702	    stdout_file="${tmpdir}/${name}.stdout"
703	    stderr_file="${tmpdir}/${name}.stderr"
704	    result_path="${cell_dir}/result.json"
705	
706	    set +e
707	    printf '%s' "${synthetic_task_spec}" | HARBOR_TASK_EXECUTOR_DRY_RUN=1 "${f}" \
708	      >"${stdout_file}" 2>"${stderr_file}"
709	    status=$?
710	    set -e
711	    if [[ ${status} -ne 0 ]]; then
712	      die "validate: task-executor ${name} failed: $(<"${stderr_file}")"
713	    fi
714	    [[ -s "${result_path}" ]] || die "validate: task-executor ${name} did not write ${result_path}"
715	    jq -e '.' "${result_path}" >/dev/null \
716	      || die "validate: task-executor ${name} wrote invalid JSON to result.json"
717	    jq -e '.' "${stdout_file}" >/dev/null \
718	      || die "validate: task-executor ${name} wrote invalid JSON to stdout"
719	  done

769	
770	# compute_harbor_source_sha mirrors build-harbor-runner.sh's algorithm: a
771	# sha256 over harbor_adapters/* + harbor_agent.py + Dockerfile.harbor-runner.
772	# Kept in sync by re-computing the same inputs; the two scripts MUST agree.
773	compute_harbor_source_sha() {
774	  local adapters_dir="${SCRIPT_DIR}/harbor_adapters"
775	  local agent_file="${SCRIPT_DIR}/harbor_agent.py"
776	  local dockerfile="${SCRIPT_DIR}/Dockerfile.harbor-runner"
777	  [[ -d "${adapters_dir}" ]] || die "preflight: harbor_adapters/ missing (${adapters_dir})"
778	  [[ -f "${agent_file}" ]] || die "preflight: harbor_agent.py missing (${agent_file})"
779	  [[ -f "${dockerfile}" ]] || die "preflight: Dockerfile.harbor-runner missing (${dockerfile})"
780	  {
781	    LC_ALL=C find "${adapters_dir}" -type f \
782	      | LC_ALL=C sort \
783	      | while IFS= read -r f; do
784	          printf '%s  %s\n' "$(sha256sum "${f}" | awk '{print $1}')" "${f#"${SCRIPT_DIR}/"}"
785	        done
786	    printf '%s  %s\n' "$(sha256sum "${agent_file}" | awk '{print $1}')" "harbor_agent.py"
787	    printf '%s  %s\n' "$(sha256sum "${dockerfile}" | awk '{print $1}')" "Dockerfile.harbor-runner"
788	  } | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'
789	}

791	# cached_harbor_image_sha prints the image-content-sha label of the cached

799	cmd_preflight() {
800	  require_tool sha256sum
801	
802	  local failed=0
803	  local source_sha cached_sha
804	  local state_dir host_state_dir lock_dir probe
805	  local build_output build_rc
806	
807	  printf 'preflight checklist:\n'
808	
809	  check_tool() {
810	    local tool="$1"
811	    if command -v "${tool}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
812	      printf '  [x] %s (%s)\n' "${tool}" "$(command -v "${tool}")"
813	      return 0
814	    fi
815	    printf '  [ ] %s (missing)\n' "${tool}"
816	    failed=1
817	    return 1
818	  }
819	
820	  check_writable_dir() {
821	    local label="$1" dir="$2" tmp
822	    if mkdir -p "${dir}" 2>/dev/null; then
823	      tmp="${dir}/.preflight.$$"
824	      if : >"${tmp}" 2>/dev/null; then
825	        rm -f "${tmp}"
826	        printf '  [x] %s (%s)\n' "${label}" "${dir}"
827	        return 0
828	      fi
829	    fi
830	    printf '  [ ] %s (%s not writable)\n' "${label}" "${dir}"
831	    failed=1
832	    return 1
833	  }
834	
835	  check_tool yq
836	  check_tool jq
837	  check_tool docker
838	  check_tool setsid
839	  check_tool flock
840	
841	  state_dir="$(in_flight_state_dir)"
842	  lock_dir="${FIZEAU_BENCH_STATE_DIR}/locks"
843	  check_writable_dir "benchmark state dir" "${state_dir}"
844	  check_writable_dir "benchmark lock dir" "${lock_dir}"
845	
846	  source_sha="$(compute_harbor_source_sha)"
847	  cached_sha="$(cached_harbor_image_sha "${HARBOR_IMAGE_TAG}")"
848	  printf '  [x] harbor source fingerprint (%s)\n' "${source_sha}"
849	  printf '  [x] cached harbor image fingerprint (%s)\n' "${cached_sha:-<none>}"
850	
851	  if [[ -n "${cached_sha}" && "${cached_sha}" == "${source_sha}" ]]; then
852	    printf '  [x] harbor-runner image up to date (%s)\n' "${HARBOR_IMAGE_TAG}"
853	  else
854	    if [[ ! -x "${HARBOR_BUILD_SCRIPT}" ]]; then
855	      printf '  [ ] harbor-runner build script executable (%s missing or not executable)\n' "${HARBOR_BUILD_SCRIPT}"
856	      failed=1
857	    else
858	      printf '  [*] building harbor-runner image via %s\n' "${HARBOR_BUILD_SCRIPT}"
859	      set +e
860	      build_output="$(IMAGE_TAG="${HARBOR_IMAGE_TAG}" "${HARBOR_BUILD_SCRIPT}" 2>&1)"
861	      build_rc=$?
862	      set -e
863	      printf '%s\n' "${build_output}"
864	      if [[ ${build_rc} -eq 0 ]]; then
865	        printf '  [x] harbor-runner image buildable (%s)\n' "${HARBOR_IMAGE_TAG}"
866	      else
867	        printf '  [ ] harbor-runner image buildable (%s)\n' "${HARBOR_IMAGE_TAG}"
868	        failed=1
869	      fi
870	    fi
871	  fi
872	
873	  if [[ ${failed} -ne 0 ]]; then
874	    printf 'preflight: one or more checks failed\n' >&2
875	    return 1
876	  fi
877	
878	  printf 'preflight: all checks passed\n'
879	}

939	harbor_runner_image_digest() {

979	# compose_env_redacted prints command-spec env with secret_env_keys replaced
980	# by a redaction sentinel. Order-insensitive; entries missing from env are
981	# ignored.
982	compose_env_redacted() {
983	  local env_json="$1" secret_keys_json="$2"
984	  jq -c --argjson secrets "${secret_keys_json}" '
985	    . as $env
986	    | reduce ($secrets[]? | tostring) as $k
987	        ($env; if has($k) then .[$k] = "***REDACTED***" else . end)

991	# is_transient_stderr greps the executor's stderr for known transient error
992	# signatures: connection refused/reset, HTTP 5xx, unexpected/EOF parse.
993	is_transient_stderr() {
994	  local f="$1"
995	  [[ -s "${f}" ]] || return 1
996	  LC_ALL=C grep -qE 'connection refused|connection reset|HTTP 5[0-9][0-9]|status[ =:]?5[0-9][0-9]|status_code=5[0-9][0-9]|unexpected EOF|EOF parse|EOF while|temporarily unavailable' "${f}"
997	}

999	# Invoke the task-executor with bounded exponential backoff on transient
1000	# errors. Returns 0 on success; non-zero on terminal failure after retries.
1001	# Captures attempts log to ${cell_dir}/retry-log.txt for forensics.
1002	run_executor_with_retry() {
1003	  local task_spec="$1" cell_dir="$2" executor="$3"
1004	  local stderr_file
1005	  stderr_file="$(mktemp)"
1006	  local max_attempts="${BENCH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS}"
1007	  local backoff="${BENCH_RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE}"
1008	  local attempt=1
1009	  local status=0
1010	  local retry_log="${cell_dir}/retry-log.txt"
1011	  : >"${retry_log}"
1012	  while :; do
1013	    : >"${stderr_file}"
1014	    set +e
1015	    printf '%s' "${task_spec}" | "${executor}" 2>"${stderr_file}" >/dev/null
1016	    status=$?
1017	    set -e
1018	    printf 'attempt=%d status=%d\n' "${attempt}" "${status}" >>"${retry_log}"
1019	    if [[ ${status} -eq 0 ]]; then
1020	      rm -f "${stderr_file}"
1021	      return 0
1022	    fi
1023	    cat "${stderr_file}" >>"${retry_log}"
1024	    if (( attempt > max_attempts )) || ! is_transient_stderr "${stderr_file}"; then
1025	      cat "${stderr_file}" >&2
1026	      rm -f "${stderr_file}"
1027	      return "${status}"
1028	    fi
1029	    warn "cell $(basename "${cell_dir}"): transient error (attempt ${attempt}); sleeping ${backoff}s"
1030	    sleep "${backoff}"
1031	    backoff=$((backoff * 2))
1032	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
1033	  done
1034	}

1050	# Count existing terminal cells matching (profile_id, task) under <out>; also
1051	# emit lists of invalid cells and orphan cells (cells with cell-state.json
1052	# and no terminal report.json). Lines are written to the named output paths.
1053	inspect_existing_cells() {
1054	  local out="$1" dataset_dir="$2" task="$3" profile_id="$4"
1055	  local terminal_out="$5" invalid_out="$6" orphan_out="$7"
1056	  : >"${terminal_out}"
1057	  : >"${invalid_out}"
1058	  : >"${orphan_out}"
1059	  local task_dir="${out}/cells/${dataset_dir}/${task}"
1060	  [[ -d "${task_dir}" ]] || return 0
1061	  local cell
1062	  shopt -s nullglob
1063	  for cell in "${task_dir}"/*/; do
1064	    local cdir="${cell%/}"
1065	    local report="${cdir}/report.json"
1066	    local state="${cdir}/cell-state.json"
1067	    if [[ -f "${report}" ]]; then
1068	      local pid status inv
1069	      pid="$(jq -r '.profile.id // ""' "${report}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
1070	      [[ "${pid}" == "${profile_id}" ]] || continue
1071	      status="$(jq -r '.final_status // ""' "${report}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
1072	      inv="$(jq -r '.invalid_class // ""' "${report}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
1073	      if [[ -n "${inv}" ]]; then
1074	        printf '%s\n' "${cdir}" >>"${invalid_out}"
1075	        continue
1076	      fi
1077	      if is_terminal_status "${status}"; then
1078	        printf '%s\n' "${cdir}" >>"${terminal_out}"
1079	      fi
1080	      continue
1081	    fi
1082	    if [[ -f "${state}" ]]; then
1083	      local pid
1084	      pid="$(jq -r '.profile // ""' "${state}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
1085	      [[ -z "${pid}" || "${pid}" == "${profile_id}" ]] || continue
1086	      printf '%s\n' "${cdir}" >>"${orphan_out}"
1087	    fi
1088	  done
1089	  shopt -u nullglob
1090	}

1092	# compute_cell_cost prints the cost_usd_at_run_time for a single cell. Uses
1093	# profile.pricing × token streams pulled from the cell's result.json. Token
1094	# field names follow the canonical report-level naming
1095	# (input_tokens / output_tokens / cached_input_tokens) and are also probed
1096	# under the harbor totals naming (total_prompt_tokens / total_completion_tokens
1097	# / total_cached_input_tokens) so harness-native token reporters land in the
1098	# same accumulator.
1099	#
1100	# When profile.pricing is all zero (or unset) and the executor wrote an
1101	# explicit cost_usd / total_cost_usd in result.json, the explicit value is
1102	# honored — that lets harnesses that observe API-reported cost directly
1103	# participate in budget enforcement.
1104	compute_cell_cost() {
1105	  local result_json="${1:-}" profile_json="${2:-}"
1106	  [[ -n "${result_json}" ]] || result_json='{}'
1107	  [[ -n "${profile_json}" ]] || profile_json='{}'
1108	  jq -nr \
1109	    --argjson result "${result_json}" \
1110	    --argjson profile "${profile_json}" \
1111	    '
1112	      def num(v): if (v == null) then 0 else (v | tonumber? // 0) end;
1113	      ($profile.pricing // {}) as $p
1114	      | num($p.input_usd_per_mtok)         as $pi
1115	      | num($p.output_usd_per_mtok)        as $po
1116	      | num($p.cached_input_usd_per_mtok)  as $pc
1117	      | num($result.input_tokens
1118	            // $result.total_prompt_tokens
1119	            // $result.n_input_tokens
1120	            // 0)                          as $ti
1121	      | num($result.output_tokens
1122	            // $result.total_completion_tokens
1123	            // $result.n_output_tokens
1124	            // 0)                          as $to
1125	      | num($result.cached_input_tokens
1126	            // $result.total_cached_input_tokens
1127	            // $result.n_cached_input_tokens
1128	            // 0)                          as $tc
1129	      | num($result.cost_usd // $result.total_cost_usd // 0) as $reported
1130	      | (($ti * $pi) + ($to * $po) + ($tc * $pc)) / 1000000  as $priced
1131	      | (if $priced > 0 then $priced
1132	         elif ($pi + $po + $pc) == 0 then $reported
1133	         else 0
1134	         end)
1135	      | tostring
1136	    '
1137	}

1139	# budget_path prints the canonical budget.json path under <out>.
1140	budget_path() {
1141	  printf '%s\n' "$1/budget.json"
1142	}

1144	# init_budget writes <out>/budget.json with the configured cap and an empty
1145	# accumulator. Idempotent: preserves existing cells/total when the cap
1146	# matches (resume case).
1147	init_budget() {
1148	  local out="$1" cap="$2"
1149	  local bp
1150	  bp="$(budget_path "${out}")"
1151	  if [[ -f "${bp}" ]]; then
1152	    local prev_cap
1153	    prev_cap="$(jq -r '.max_cost_usd // ""' "${bp}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
1154	    if [[ "${prev_cap}" == "${cap}" ]]; then
1155	      return 0
1156	    fi
1157	  fi
1158	  jq -n \
1159	    --argjson cap "${cap}" \
1160	    '{max_cost_usd:$cap, total_cost_usd:0, halted:false, cells:[]}' \
1161	    >"${bp}.tmp"
1162	  mv "${bp}.tmp" "${bp}"
1163	}

1165	# append_budget_cell folds one closed cell's cost into budget.json and prints
1166	# the post-update total_cost_usd. Halted flag flips true when the running
1167	# total meets or exceeds the cap.
1168	append_budget_cell() {
1169	  local out="$1" cell_id="$2" task="$3" profile_id="$4" cost="$5"
1170	  local bp tmp
1171	  bp="$(budget_path "${out}")"
1172	  tmp="$(mktemp)"
1173	  jq \
1174	    --arg cell_id "${cell_id}" \
1175	    --arg task "${task}" \
1176	    --arg profile "${profile_id}" \
1177	    --argjson cost "${cost}" \
1178	    '
1179	      .cells += [{cell_id:$cell_id, task:$task, profile:$profile, cost_usd:$cost}]
1180	      | .total_cost_usd = ((.total_cost_usd // 0) + $cost)
1181	      | .halted = ((.total_cost_usd >= (.max_cost_usd // 0))
1182	                   and ((.max_cost_usd // 0) > 0))
1183	    ' "${bp}" >"${tmp}"
1184	  mv "${tmp}" "${bp}"
1185	  jq -r '.total_cost_usd' "${bp}"
1186	}

1188	# budget_is_halted exits 0 when the budget cap has been hit (halted=true in

1475	# run_cell_with_per_cell_retry invokes run_one_cell with per-cell retry logic
1476	# for transient errors. Each retry attempt gets a fresh cell_id and cell_dir,
1477	# linked via attempt_of/superseded_by. Returns the final cell_dir.
1478	# initial_attempt_of="" disables initial attempt_of tracking.
1479	run_cell_with_per_cell_retry() {
1480	  local out="$1" profile_id="$2" profile_file="$3"
1481	  local framework="$4" dataset="$5" dataset_dir="$6" task="$7"
1482	  local rep_idx="$8" total_reps="$9" adapter="${10}"
1483	  local te_ver="${11}" hd="${12}" interrupted_flag="${13:-}" initial_attempt_of="${14:-}"
1484	
1485	  local max_attempts="${BENCH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS}"
1486	  local backoff="${BENCH_RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE}"
1487	  local attempt=1
1488	  local prior_cell_dir="${initial_attempt_of}"
1489	
1490	  while :; do
1491	    local cell_dir
1492	    cell_dir="$(run_one_cell "${out}" "${profile_id}" "${profile_file}" \
1493	                  "${framework}" "${dataset}" "${dataset_dir}" "${task}" \
1494	                  "${rep_idx}" "${total_reps}" "${adapter}" "${prior_cell_dir}" \
1495	                  "${te_ver}" "${hd}" "${interrupted_flag}")"
1496	
1497	    if [[ ! -f "${cell_dir}/report.json" ]]; then
1498	      # No result to check, just return the cell
1499	      printf '%s\n' "${cell_dir}"
1500	      return 0
1501	    fi
1502	
1503	    local error_class final_status
1504	    error_class="$(jq -r '.error_class // ""' "${cell_dir}/report.json" 2>/dev/null || printf '')"
1505	    final_status="$(jq -r '.final_status // ""' "${cell_dir}/report.json" 2>/dev/null || printf '')"
1506	
1507	    # If non-transient error or success, stop retrying
1508	    if [[ -z "${error_class}" ]] || ! is_transient_error_class "${error_class}"; then
1509	      printf '%s\n' "${cell_dir}"
1510	      return 0
1511	    fi
1512	
1513	    # If max attempts reached, mark final cell with transient_exhausted and stop
1514	    if (( attempt >= max_attempts )); then
1515	      local tmp
1516	      tmp="$(mktemp)"
1517	      jq '. + {final_status:"transient_exhausted"}' "${cell_dir}/report.json" >"${tmp}"
1518	      mv "${tmp}" "${cell_dir}/report.json"
1519	      printf '%s\n' "${cell_dir}"
1520	      return 0
1521	    fi
1522	
1523	    # Transient error and more attempts available: sleep and retry
1524	    warn "cell $(basename "${cell_dir}"): transient error (attempt ${attempt}/${max_attempts}); sleeping ${backoff}s before retry"
1525	    sleep "${backoff}"
1526	    backoff=$((backoff * 2))
1527	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
1528	    prior_cell_dir="${cell_dir}"
1529	  done
1530	}

1567	# run_sweep walks the (profile, bench-set, task, rep) matrix, applies resume /

1570	run_sweep() {

1585	  hd="$(harbor_runner_image_digest)"
1586	  write_sweep_metadata "${out}" "${te_ver}" "${hd}"

1588	  if [[ -n "${max_cost_usd}" ]]; then
1589	    init_budget "${out}" "${max_cost_usd}"

1591	
1592	  # Signal handling: set up interrupt flag and trap
1593	  local interrupted_flag
1594	  interrupted_flag="${FIZEAU_BENCH_STATE_DIR}/.benchmark-interrupt-$$"
1595	
1596	  # Trap handler for SIGINT/SIGTERM: interrupt running cells, wait for cleanup
1597	  handle_interrupt() {
1598	    local grace_seconds="${BENCH_TERM_GRACE_SECONDS}"
1599	    [[ -f "${interrupted_flag}" ]] && return 0
1600	    warn "Received signal, stopping cell submission and interrupting running cells..."
1601	    touch "${interrupted_flag}"
1602	
1603	    # Terminate in-flight cells
1604	    interrupt_inflight_cells
1605	
1606	    # Send SIGTERM to all child processes (the background job pool)
1607	    local pids
1608	    pids="$(jobs -p)"
1609	    if [[ -n "${pids}" ]]; then
1610	      kill -TERM ${pids} 2>/dev/null || true
1611	
1612	      # Wait up to grace_seconds for them to exit
1613	      local elapsed=0
1614	      while (( elapsed < grace_seconds )); do
1615	        pids="$(jobs -p)"
1616	        if [[ -z "${pids}" ]]; then
1617	          break
1618	        fi
1619	        sleep 1
1620	        elapsed=$((elapsed + 1))
1621	      done
1622	
1623	      # Force kill any stragglers
1624	      pids="$(jobs -p)"
1625	      if [[ -n "${pids}" ]]; then
1626	        kill -KILL ${pids} 2>/dev/null || true
1627	      fi
1628	    fi
1629	  }

1631	  trap 'handle_interrupt' SIGINT SIGTERM
1632	
1633	  local active_jobs=0
1634	
1635	  IFS=',' read -r -a profile_ids <<<"${profiles_csv}"
1636	  IFS=',' read -r -a bench_set_ids <<<"${bench_sets_csv}"

1638	  local profile_id bs_id bs_file profile_file

1640	  local terminal_file invalid_file orphan_file
1641	  local concurrency_group
1642	
1643	  for profile_id in "${profile_ids[@]}"; do
1644	    [[ -n "${profile_id}" ]] || continue
1645	    profile_file="$(resolve_profile_file "${profile_id}")"
1646	    local profile_json_full harness
1647	    profile_json_full="$(yq -o=json '.' "${profile_file}")"
1648	    harness="$(jq -r '.harness // "none"' <<<"${profile_json_full}")"
1649	    adapter="$(resolve_adapter_for_harness "${harness}")"
1650	    concurrency_group="$(jq -r '.concurrency_group // "default"' <<<"${profile_json_full}")"
1651	
1652	    for bs_id in "${bench_set_ids[@]}"; do
1653	      [[ -n "${bs_id}" ]] || continue
1654	      bs_file="$(resolve_bench_set_file "${bs_id}")"
1655	      framework="$(bench_set_framework "${bs_file}")"
1656	      dataset="$(bench_set_dataset "${bs_file}")"
1657	      dataset_dir="${dataset}"
1658	      if [[ -n "${reps_override}" ]]; then
1659	        reps="${reps_override}"
1660	      else
1661	        reps="$(bench_set_reps "${bs_file}")"
1662	      fi
1663	      tasks="$(resolve_tasks "${bs_file}")"

1669

1673

1676	        invalid_count="$(wc -l <"${invalid_file}" | tr -d ' ')"
1677	        orphan_count="$(wc -l <"${orphan_file}" | tr -d ' ')"

1680	        if [[ ${force_rerun} -eq 1 ]]; then
1681	          local r
1682	          for ((r = 1; r <= reps; r++)); do
1683	            cells_to_run+=("${profile_id}|${profile_file}|${framework}|${dataset}|${dataset_dir}|${task}|${r}|${reps}|${adapter}|${te_ver}|${hd}|${max_cost_usd}|${concurrency_group}|")

1685	        elif [[ ${retry_invalid} -eq 1 ]]; then
1686	          local prior
1687	          while IFS= read -r prior; do
1688	            [[ -n "${prior}" ]] || continue
1689	            cells_to_run+=("${profile_id}|${profile_file}|${framework}|${dataset}|${dataset_dir}|${task}|1|${reps}|${adapter}|${te_ver}|${hd}|${max_cost_usd}|${concurrency_group}|${prior}")
1690	          done <"${invalid_file}"
1691	          while IFS= read -r prior; do
1692	            [[ -n "${prior}" ]] || continue
1693	            cells_to_run+=("${profile_id}|${profile_file}|${framework}|${dataset}|${dataset_dir}|${task}|1|${reps}|${adapter}|${te_ver}|${hd}|${max_cost_usd}|${concurrency_group}|${prior}")
1694	          done <"${orphan_file}"
1695	          warn "retry-invalid: profile=${profile_id} task=${task} reran invalid=${invalid_count} orphan=${orphan_count}"
1696	        else
1697	          if [[ ${terminal_count} -ge ${reps} ]]; then
1698	            warn "skip: profile=${profile_id} task=${task} (terminal_cells=${terminal_count} >= reps=${reps})"
1699	          else
1700	            local need r idx
1701	            need=$((reps - terminal_count))
1702	            idx=$((terminal_count + 1))
1703	            for ((r = 1; r <= need; r++)); do
1704	              cells_to_run+=("${profile_id}|${profile_file}|${framework}|${dataset}|${dataset_dir}|${task}|${idx}|${reps}|${adapter}|${te_ver}|${hd}|${max_cost_usd}|${concurrency_group}")
1705	              idx=$((idx + 1))
1706	            done
1707	          fi
1708	        fi
1709	
1710	        # Run cells with job pool and concurrency-group locking
1711	        for cell_spec in "${cells_to_run[@]}"; do
1712	          # Wait for a job slot to become available
1713	          while (( active_jobs >= jobs )); do
1714	            wait -n 2>/dev/null || true
1715	            active_jobs=$((active_jobs - 1))
1716	          done
1717	
1718	          # Check if we've been interrupted
1719	          if [[ -f "${interrupted_flag}" ]]; then
1720	            warn "Stopping cell submission due to signal interrupt"
1721	            # Wait for remaining jobs
1722	            wait
1723	            rm -f "${interrupted_flag}" "${terminal_file}" "${invalid_file}" "${orphan_file}"
1724	            trap - SIGINT SIGTERM
1725	            return 130
1726	          fi
1727	
1728	          # Parse cell spec
1729	          IFS='|' read -r p_id p_file fw ds ds_dir tsk rep_idx t_reps adp te_v hd_v cap cg prior_cell <<<"${cell_spec}"
1730	
1731	          # Acquire concurrency-group lock
1732	          local lock_fd
1733	          lock_fd="$(acquire_group_lock "${cg}")"
1734	
1735	          # Run cell in a fresh session so the worker PID is a killable
1736	          # process-group leader for signal handling.
1737	          export_cell_worker_functions
1738	          launch_cell_worker "${lock_fd}" \
1739	            "${out}" "${p_id}" "${p_file}" \
1740	            "${fw}" "${ds}" "${ds_dir}" "${tsk}" \
1741	            "${rep_idx}" "${t_reps}" "${adp}" \
1742	            "${te_v}" "${hd_v}" "${cap}" "${interrupted_flag}" "${prior_cell}"
1743	
1744	          active_jobs=$((active_jobs + 1))
1745	        done
1746	
1747	        rm -f "${terminal_file}" "${invalid_file}" "${orphan_file}"
1748	      done <<<"${tasks}"
1749	    done
1750	  done
1751	
1752	  # Wait for all background jobs to complete
1753	  wait
1754	  local exit_code=0
1755	  [[ -f "${interrupted_flag}" ]] && exit_code=130
1756	  rm -f "${interrupted_flag}"
1757	  trap - SIGINT SIGTERM
1758	  return "${exit_code}"

1869	      *)                positional+=("$1"); shift ;;

1894	      if [[ -z "${out}" ]]; then

1897	      if [[ ${force_rerun} -eq 1 && ${retry_invalid} -eq 1 ]]; then

1900	      if [[ -n "${max_cost_usd}" ]]; then

1909	        "${max_cost_usd}" "${jobs}"

392	# Handles three shapes:
393	#   tasks: [id, id, ...]         inline list
394	#   tasks: all                   defer to harness dataset; emit "*all*"
395	#   tasks_from: <path>           load tasks[].id from a sibling YAML
396	# tasks_from and inline tasks merge in deterministic order with duplicates
397	# removed on first occurrence.
398	resolve_tasks() {
399	  local bs_file="$1"
400	  local bs_json tasks_kind tasks_from
401	  bs_json="$(bench_set_json "${bs_file}")"
402	
403	  tasks_kind="$(jq -r '
404	    if (.tasks // null) == null then "none"
405	    elif (.tasks | type) == "array" then "list"
406	    elif (.tasks | type) == "string" then ("string:" + .tasks)
407	    else "other"
408	    end' <<<"${bs_json}")"
409	
410	  tasks_from="$(jq -r '.tasks_from // ""' <<<"${bs_json}")"
411	
412	  if [[ "${tasks_kind}" == "string:all" ]]; then
413	    [[ -z "${tasks_from}" ]] || die "bench-set ${bs_file}: tasks: all cannot be combined with tasks_from"

418	  fi
419	
420	  local -A seen_tasks=()
421	  local emitted=0
422	  local task resolved
423	
424	  emit_task() {
425	    local task="$1"
426	    [[ -n "${task}" ]] || return 0

436	    [[ -f "${resolved}" ]] || die "tasks_from path not found: ${tasks_from} (resolved to ${resolved})"

444	          '
445	    )

448	  if [[ "${tasks_kind}" == "list" ]]; then

459	    if [[ -n "${tasks_from}" || "${tasks_kind}" == "list" ]]; then

2	# scripts/benchmark/benchmark — operator-facing benchmark driver.
3	#
4	# Replaces `fiz-bench sweep` / `fiz-bench matrix` execution. Pure shell:
5	# yq + jq + sha256sum + docker. No Go bridge, no Python.
6	#
7	# Bead fizeau-fe87a3ac: skeleton + listing subcommands + --plan mode +
8	# preflight rebuild gate. The cell execution loop (resume, retry, signal
9	# handling, concurrency, budget) lands in a follow-up bead.
10	#
11	# Operator contract:
12	#   ./benchmark profiles
13	#   ./benchmark bench-sets
14	#   ./benchmark harness-adapters
15	#   ./benchmark task-executors
16	#   ./benchmark validate                            # placeholder; see PR C
17	#   ./benchmark preflight                           # rebuild harbor-runner if sha drifted
18	#   ./benchmark --profile P[,P2,...] --bench-set B[,B2,...] --plan
19	#   ./benchmark --profile P[,P2,...] --bench-set B[,B2,...]   # run path; PR A4
20	#
21	# Rules:
22	#   1. --plan is pure: no file writes, no Docker pulls/builds, no
23	#      benchmark-results/ creation. Prints one matrix line per cell.
24	#   2. --profile and --bench-set are both required for --plan and run.
25	#   3. preflight is the only command that touches Docker.
26	
27	set -euo pipefail
28	
29	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
30	PROFILES_DIR="${PROFILES_DIR:-${SCRIPT_DIR}/profiles}"
31	BENCH_SETS_DIR="${BENCH_SETS_DIR:-${SCRIPT_DIR}/bench-sets}"

39	BENCH_RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE="${BENCH_RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE:-1}"

59	die() { printf 'benchmark: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

62	require_tool() {
63	  command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "required tool not found: $1"
64	}

66	# in_flight_state_dir returns the host-specific state directory.
67	in_flight_state_dir() {
68	  local hostname

70	  printf '%s/%s\n' "${FIZEAU_BENCH_STATE_DIR}" "${hostname}"
71	}
72	
73	# in_flight_lock_path returns the lock path for a concurrency group.
74	in_flight_lock_path() {
75	  local group="$1"
76	  printf '%s/locks/%s.lock\n' "${FIZEAU_BENCH_STATE_DIR}" "${group}"
77	}
78	
79	# in_flight_json_path returns the path to the in-flight state JSON file.
80	in_flight_json_path() {
81	  printf '%s/in-flight.json\n' "$(in_flight_state_dir)"
82	}
83	
84	# acquire_group_lock acquires an flock for a concurrency group, blocking if needed.
85	# Returns 0 on success, prints the lock fd to stdout.
86	acquire_group_lock() {
87	  local group="$1"

770	# compute_harbor_source_sha mirrors build-harbor-runner.sh's algorithm: a
771	# sha256 over harbor_adapters/* + harbor_agent.py + Dockerfile.harbor-runner.
772	# Kept in sync by re-computing the same inputs; the two scripts MUST agree.
773	compute_harbor_source_sha() {
774	  local adapters_dir="${SCRIPT_DIR}/harbor_adapters"
775	  local agent_file="${SCRIPT_DIR}/harbor_agent.py"
776	  local dockerfile="${SCRIPT_DIR}/Dockerfile.harbor-runner"
777	  [[ -d "${adapters_dir}" ]] || die "preflight: harbor_adapters/ missing (${adapters_dir})"
778	  [[ -f "${agent_file}" ]] || die "preflight: harbor_agent.py missing (${agent_file})"
779	  [[ -f "${dockerfile}" ]] || die "preflight: Dockerfile.harbor-runner missing (${dockerfile})"
780	  {
781	    LC_ALL=C find "${adapters_dir}" -type f \
782	      | LC_ALL=C sort \
783	      | while IFS= read -r f; do
784	          printf '%s  %s\n' "$(sha256sum "${f}" | awk '{print $1}')" "${f#"${SCRIPT_DIR}/"}"
785	        done
786	    printf '%s  %s\n' "$(sha256sum "${agent_file}" | awk '{print $1}')" "harbor_agent.py"
787	    printf '%s  %s\n' "$(sha256sum "${dockerfile}" | awk '{print $1}')" "Dockerfile.harbor-runner"
788	  } | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'
789	}

# Acceptance tests for --plan mode.
# Bead fizeau-2eeb9a43: AC1-3
# - Test_PlanIsPure: Verify --plan --profile sindri-lucebox --bench-set tb-2-1-canary creates no files
# - Test_PlanPrintsMatrix: Verify --plan prints 9 lines (3 tasks × 3 reps) for canary
# - Test_ListingSubcommands_profiles: Verify ./benchmark profiles lists profiles including sindri-lucebox
# - Test_ListingSubcommands_bench_sets: Verify ./benchmark bench-sets lists bench-sets including tb-2-1-canary
# - Test_Validate: Verify ./benchmark validate exits 0

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && cd .. && pwd)"
BENCHMARK="${SCRIPT_DIR}/benchmark"

# Test 1: --plan is pure: no files created
@test "Test_PlanIsPure" {
  local tmpdir
  tmpdir="$(mktemp -d)"
  trap "rm -rf '${tmpdir}'" RETURN

  # Run --plan with explicit --out to be sure it doesn't create anything
  local output
  output="$("${BENCHMARK}" \
    --profile sindri-lucebox \
    --bench-set tb-2-1-canary \
    --plan \
    --out "${tmpdir}/should-not-be-created" 2>&1)"

  # Verify the output directory was not created
  [[ ! -d "${tmpdir}/should-not-be-created" ]]

  # Verify no files were written at all in tmpdir
  [[ ! "$(find "${tmpdir}" -type f 2>/dev/null)" ]]
}

@test "Test_PlanPrintsMatrix" {
  local output line_count
  output="$("${BENCHMARK}" \
    --profile sindri-lucebox \
    --bench-set tb-2-1-canary \
    --plan 2>&1)"

  line_count="$(printf '%s\n' "${output}" | wc -l)"

  [[ "${line_count}" -eq 9 ]]

  while IFS= read -r line; do

  printf '%s\n' "${output}" | grep -Fxq 'sindri-lucebox'
